ranking_contract.dense: locked direct ONNX BGE embeddings with exact matrix cosine
ranking_contract.hybrid: fixed reciprocal rank fusion with RRF_K=60
ranking_contract.lexical: Chinese characters plus adjacent bigrams and lowercased English/alphanumeric tokens scored by BM25(k1=1.2,b=0.75)

timing_note: One locked encoder and one batched query encoding were reused for dense and hybrid; hybrid timing is the fixed RRF fusion step.
